I’m Mattias Reinhardt.

I’m a computer engineering student at Suffolk County Community College.

I spent a semester at art school, and I love printmaking. I also make apps and write programs, including a Python orbital simulation and Elite Hypertrophy.

I’m drawn to things with character: rough prints, nature, Terraria, monkeys, and bears. I wanted a website where that could sit alongside my programming projects.
